summary: Fee configuration tool malfunction in Sales UI
description: Upon configuring fees and services for a new location linked to an existing merchant ID, the Sales Agent noticed that the settings were missing or not applied. This led to discrepancies in the merchant agreement.
resolution: Reviewed and adjusted the permission settings for the Merchant UI, allowing the merchant to successfully e-sign the agreement and proceed with onboarding.
